note: Forest Preserve District of Kane County campground in Big Rock Forest Preserve, on a paved figure-eight loop of open, mostly unshaded spurs with a pond on its east side. Tent and equestrian sites sit apart on their own areas. --Claude
summary: Kane FPD page, 2025 rules, FAQ PDF and inset map read; imagery checked. 96 improved back-in sites, 50/30/20 A with water (+9 walk-in tent, 4 equestrian on a separate oval). $26 resident / $41 non-resident (no resident-only restriction or booking window; online reservations open to all April 1). No showers, dump yes. Season May 1 - third Sunday in October. Booking operator (activityreg). Horse sites are explicitly separate -> keep. Pin is on the Granart Rd entrance ~470 m from the loop -> move. Not waterfront kept; pond lead for 78-84.
flags: HORSE AREA (separate, keep): the inset map puts the '4 Equestrian Camp Sites' E1-E4 on their own small oval loop with 'Equestrian Shelter #2', off the entrance road and apart from the 96-site loop; equestrian sites are booked only by phone (FAQ). Explicitly separated, so the horse rule does not drop it.

RESIDENT RESTRICTION: none. Only the price differs ('Kane County residents: $26/day Nonresidents: $41/day'); reservations open to everyone April 1 at 9 a.m. No resident-only window found on the page, rules or FAQ.

PIN MOVE (~470 m): stored 41.75827,-88.51802 is the campground entrance on Granart Rd (on imagery, the drive's junction with the road). The site loop's centre is about 41.7545,-88.5155 (camp office ~41.7565,-88.5170). Proposed target 41.7545,-88.5155.

WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront; kept): the pond east of the loop is about 1.6 ha (~4 acres), so a pond, not a lake. Sites 78-84 pad ends lie about 35-45 m from its shore across unmown prairie grass and a cattail/reed fringe (Esri imagery, 0.58 m/px). Not clearly an open walkable apron, and there's no pond-view value. LEAD only: 'pond' for sites 78-84 if photos show open mown ground to the water.
SEASON: opens 05-01 (stored) and closes the third Sunday in October (10-17 in 2027; no close stored before).
FIT: no site length published; spurs on imagery are long paved back-ins (~15-20 m). Stored max_rig_ft 50 has no source on any page read; left as is (I did not write sites.max_rig_ft).
Old note claims ('96 improved drive-in electric/water sites, 2 dump stations, no showers ... Seasonal May 1-mid Oct; reservations') now sit in fields; rewritten.
